descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
📣 Would you like to join a company that puts people at the heart of its concerns? We are waiting for you! Since 2007, Extia, an IT consulting company, has been offering a unique approach in its field by combining well-being at work and performance.
 Our philosophy at Extia is “First who, then what", so let's go for it!
 🚀First who? 
Naturally curious, always eager to explore new technologies and find better ways of doing things.
A team player who enjoys sharing knowledge, exchanging ideas and helping others grow.
Proactive and comfortable taking ownership, from understanding a challenge to finding the right solution.
 This position is hybrid, requiring 2-3 days per week in the Bucharest OR Brasov office. 
 🚀Then what? 
 We are looking for an iOS Developer to join our banking client’s team and contribute to the development of mobile applications, taking part in the entire feature journey, from initial concept to production and ongoing support.
 You will work closely with developers, product owners and architects to shape technical solutions, improve application architecture and ensure high-quality delivery within an Agile environment.
 Responsibilities: 
Contribute to all stages of the Agile development lifecycle , including planning, design, development, testing, deployment and production support.
Lead code reviews , ensuring code quality and encouraging knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.
Collaborate with the lead developer, technical product owner and enterprise architect to define technical solutions for new features.
Identify and propose architectural improvements and contribute to their implementation.
Troubleshoot and debug issues to optimize application performance and stability.
Stay up to date with emerging technologies and trends in the mobile development ecosystem.
Share technical expertise, promote best practices and provide functional support to team members.
 Requirements: 
Proven experience in iOS development with Swift and SwiftUI , backed by relevant projects.
Good knowledge of mobile architectures, RESTful APIs and emerging technologies (e.g. KMP).
Ability to translate complex business and functional requirements into technical specifications.
Experience integrating third-party SDKs and services (e.g. camera, document scanning, electronic signature).
Understanding of mobile UX/UI , monitoring and logging solutions (e.g. Firebase Crashlytics).
Familiarity with Firebase services , Azure DevOps , CI/CD pipelines and Agile/Scrum .
Fluent in English.
 🚀 Do you recognize yourself in the "Who" and represent the "What"? Apply and let's talk!
